label: communicated to
definition: Argument 1 addressed, contacted or sent a message to argument 2.
scope_notes: Tell, urge, ask, notify, speak-to and message/report recipient paths establish direction. Accusing or describing a person without addressing them is not enough. Sending something unspecified may require object/attachment review.

facts.reason: Congress sends something to the White House, but the omitted object prevents distinguishing a message/document submission from transferring a person or other thing.
facts.reviewer_question: What was sent by Congress to the White House, and does the full sentence establish an addressed communication?

facts.reason: The fragment involving WASHINGTON, its and today has no communication predicate or identifiable recipient relation.
Caplan heads something at the University of Pennsylvania; this is an institutional role, not a directed communication.
Torre explicitly tells, speaks to and asks Williams.
Greenspan explicitly tells, urges and advises Congress.
